$comment: Necessary but not sufficient: decimal bounds (x-gie-*), canonical order, cross-field invariants (x-gie-invariants), lifecycle rules (x-gie-behaviour), exact 64-bit integer tokens and printable-text rules are enforced by the reference implementation gie.contracts.
description: Approval, reduction or rejection of a plan, with the size and risk granted.

alternative_group_id.description: Alternative group of the plan: at most one plan of a group is ever executed.

as_of_time_ns.description: Market-data watermark: receive time of the newest market data the record depends on, directly or through its inputs.

attempt.description: 0 for the first evaluation of the plan, +1 per re-evaluation.

daily_pnl_frac.description: Account-wide net result of the trading day including open positions of all systems.

daily_state.description: Daily risk state at decision time.

data_origin.description: Least trustworthy origin among the market data the record is derived from.

decision_time_ns.description: Clock reading at which the producer created the record.

gap_stress_loss_amount.description: Aggregate loss in the gap-stress scenario including this trade.

margin_required_amount.description: Margin required for the granted volume.

mode.description: REPLAY or PAPER.  No live mode exists (routing lock).

open_risk_amount.description: Aggregate risk of open positions before this decision.

pending_risk_amount.description: Aggregate risk of pending orders and unexpired reservations before this decision.

plan_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint (gie.contracts.fingerprint) of the evaluated plan: binds the decision to its content.

producer.description: Component instance that emitted the record; together with the contract name it names the stream.

profit_floor_frac.description: Protected, non-decreasing daily profit floor; set if and only if daily_state is PROFIT_PROTECTION.

quality_model_version_id.description: That model version; set if and only if quality_validated is true.

quality_validated.description: True only when the size was adapted using quality from an owner-approved (ACTIVE) model version.

reason_codes.description: Reasons for a reduction or rejection (rule identifiers of the risk engine).

reference_equity_amount.description: Equity that the day's fractions refer to (per the account rules).

reservation_id.description: identity.reservation_id(decision_id) of the reserved risk; null when rejected.

risk_amount.description: Worst-case loss at the hard stop for the granted volume including expected costs; 0 when rejected.

risk_frac.description: risk_amount as a fraction of reference_equity_amount, rounded up; 0 when rejected.

run_id.description: Run that produced the record (see the RunManifest of that run).

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the message was written with.

seq.description: Position of the record in its stream: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1.

valid_until_ns.description: Expiry instant of the approval and its reservation; not later than the plan's expiry.

title: RiskDecision 1.0.0

identity.plan_fingerprint: fingerprint(plan): sha256 of contract name, MAJOR and fields

x-gie-invariants.rule: as_of_time_ns <= decision_time_ns (a record cannot depend on data received after it was created)
REJECTED grants nothing: volume_lots = 0, risk_amount = 0, risk_frac = 0, no reservation
an approval grants volume_lots > 0, risk_amount > 0 and risk_frac > 0 and carries reservation_id = identity.reservation_id(decision_id)
reason_codes is non-empty unless outcome is APPROVED
EMERGENCY_HALT never approves: outcome is REJECTED
profit_floor_frac is set if and only if daily_state is PROFIT_PROTECTION
at or below the profit floor no new risk is approved (G05: at exactly the floor no new risk)
above the profit floor an approval risks at most the surplus: risk_frac <= daily_pnl_frac - profit_floor_frac
risk_amount <= risk_frac * reference_equity_amount (the fraction is rounded up, never down)
an approval expires later than decision_time_ns
trading_day is the Europe/Prague calendar date of decision_time_ns
quality_model_version_id is set if and only if quality_validated is true
